mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS review_id, s.id AS snapshot_id FROM growth_review r JOIN growth_review_snapshot s ON s.id=r.current_snapshot_id AND s.review_id=r.id JOIN edu_student student ON student.id=r.student_id AND student.status='ENABLED' WHERE r.student_id=#{studentId} AND r.period_type='WEEK' AND r.period_start=#{start} AND r.period_end=#{end}
SELECT id FROM growth_review_delivery WHERE subscription_id=#{subscriptionId} AND period_start=#{start}
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_review_delivery SET status='PENDING',subscription_version=#{version},review_id=#{report.reviewId},snapshot_id=#{report.snapshotId},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='CANCELLED' AND expires_at > #{now} AND subscription_version <= #{version}
UPDATE growth_review_delivery SET status='CANCELLED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE subscription_id=#{subscriptionId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE growth_review_delivery SET status='CANCELLED',updated_at=#{now} WHERE status='PENDING' AND expires_at <= #{now}
